== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Dreadbeasts are monstrous, corrupted entities that function as lesser versions of [[sacred beasts]]. While true [[sacred beasts]] undergo a refinement process that enhances their beauty and intelligence, dreadbeasts appear diseased, rotting, and physically deformed, often looking like mismatched or cobbled-together creatures. They are characterized by a chaotic blend of conflicting auras and possess high levels of physical strength and [[advancement]], often exceeding that of the [[sacred artists]] they encounter. A defining feature of dreadbeasts is their connection to [[hunger madra]]. They consume both animals and [[Remnants]], with the latter providing them with [[madra]]. Unlike [[Remnants]], dreadbeasts retain their souls within their bodies and do not leave [[Remnants]] behind upon death. They also contain internal [[binding|bindings]] that can be harvested; these [[binding|bindings]] are sometimes used to create powerful tools, such as spears capable of stealing [[madra]]. Dreadbeasts are heavily influenced by the presence of [[Dreadgods]], becoming enraged or driven mad by their approach. Some theories suggest that dreadbeasts may be the failed attempts at creating the [[Dreadgods]], or perhaps their lesser copies. They are found in various environments, including the [[Desolate Wilds]] and within certain ruins that may serve as their birthplace.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Dreadbeasts are multi-headed masses of corrupted flesh that crash into the land like waves of the sea. These creatures gather in areas where [[vital aura]] is thick, often appearing within the [[Ruins]] to stand in the way of progress. Because they appear suddenly to attack [[Miners|miners]], mining crews require constant protection from them. During their incursions, [[Yerin]] fought a pack of twisted dreadbeasts, while an attack on [[Lindon]] resulted in him suffering from twisted fingers.}}
